tldr: Black Moon Lilith in the 5th house.
body: You refuse to perform desire or creativity for approval; raw self-expression and appetite. Strong ambivalence about creativity and children, fierce desire set against fear, and a perfectionism that can paralyze. Freed, it pours out original, non-conforming work.
shadow: Drama and risk in love and play, or creativity locked away by shame.
policy: Modern point; secondary weighting only. Not used in dignity, sect, or time-lord logic, and never treated as a primary chart ruler. Weight up only when it aspects a personal planet or angle, or sits on an angle.
